title: Point Reyes Lighthouse lantern-room source packet
scope: Read-only primary-source research and local reference downloads. No generation, demo/source/runtime edits, picks, canon changes, pushes, installs or model downloads.
selected_installation: Point Reyes Lighthouse, Point Reyes National Seashore, California. Original 1867 French lens installed1870; restoration state/dates retained separately.
same_place_proof: All HABS drawings/photos share survey CA-2250 and collection ca1357; original caption PDF identifies May1982 photos.
The official NPS 1990 HSR describes this same lighthouse and reproduces its architectural documentation.
NPS virtual-visit page explicitly identifies Point Reyes, Fresnel lens and clockwork; post-restoration2020date retained.
NPS restoration album FC56DEFA-F3A2-49F0-B843-1BF44212F1A3 identifies each selected asset as Point Reyes; exact dates and construction states remain labeled.
rights_line: LOC: no known restrictions on U.S. Government images, with caveats for copied sources; selected NPS album metadata: public domain, full granting rights; the NPS video is credited NPS/A. Kopshever and its page says multimedia should not automatically be presumed public domain.
